explanation: Over a regular local ring R every f.g. module M has finite projective dimension p (Auslander–Buchsbaum–Serre), and if p > 0 then Ext^p_R(M, R) ≠ 0 (from a minimal free resolution: the last map's dual has entries in the maximal ideal, so its cokernel is nonzero by Nakayama). Hence Ext^i(M, R) = 0 for all i > 0 forces M free. The formal statement assumes [IsRegularLocalRing R] (Mathlib's class, which includes Noetherian and local), a f.g. M and only the Ext(M, R) vanishing, concluding Module.Free R M. This is a true textbook fact matching the docstring. Faithful.
